Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator

Divide waist by height to get your waist-to-height ratio and health category — aim for under 0.5.

–
Waist-to-height ratio
–
Category

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Aim to keep your waist under half your height.

📖 How to use

  1. Measure your waist in cm at the midpoint between ribs and hips.
  2. Enter your height in cm.
  3. Press Calculate.
  4. Read your ratio and risk category.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do I measure my waist?

Measure around your waist at the midpoint between your lowest rib and hip bone, after breathing out normally.

What is a healthy ratio?

Keep your waist under half your height — a ratio below 0.5 is the widely used healthy cutoff.

Is it better than BMI?

Studies link it more closely to cardiometabolic risk than BMI alone, since it captures abdominal fat.
